new.brief: Creates a new recent manager object.
new.md:
Creates a new recent manager object.

Recent manager objects are used to handle the list of recently used
resources. A `GtkRecentManager` object monitors the recently used
resources list, and emits the [`RecentManager::changed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.RecentManager#event:changed)
signal each time something inside the list changes.

`GtkRecentManager` objects are expensive: be sure to create them
only when needed. You should use `get_default`
instead.

doc.brief: Manages and looks up recently used files.

add_full.brief: Adds a new resource, pointed by `uri`, into the recently used resources list, using the metadata specified inside the `GtkRecentData` passed in `recent_data`.
add_full.md:
Adds a new resource, pointed by `uri`, into the recently used
resources list, using the metadata specified inside the
`GtkRecentData` passed in `recent_data`.

The passed URI will be used to identify this resource inside the
list.

In order to register the new recently used resource, metadata about
the resource must be passed as well as the URI; the metadata is
stored in a `GtkRecentData`, which must contain the MIME
type of the resource pointed by the URI; the name of the application
that is registering the item, and a command line to be used when
launching the item.

Optionally, a `GtkRecentData` might contain a UTF-8 string
to be used when viewing the item instead of the last component of
the URI; a short description of the item; whether the item should
be considered private - that is, should be displayed only by the
applications that have registered it.

add_item.brief: Adds a new resource, pointed by `uri`, into the recently used resources list.
add_item.md:
Adds a new resource, pointed by `uri`, into the recently used
resources list.

This function automatically retrieves some of the needed
metadata and setting other metadata to common default values;
it then feeds the data to [`RecentManager.add_full()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.RecentManager#method:add_full).

See [`RecentManager.add_full()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.RecentManager#method:add_full) if you want to explicitly
define the metadata for the resource pointed by `uri`.

get_default.brief: Gets a unique instance of `GtkRecentManager` that you can share in your application without caring about memory management.
get_default.md:
Gets a unique instance of `GtkRecentManager` that you can share
in your application without caring about memory management.

get_items.md: Gets the list of recently used resources.

has_item.brief: Checks whether there is a recently used resource registered with `uri` inside the recent manager.
has_item.md:

lookup_item.brief: Searches for a URI inside the recently used resources list, and returns a `GtkRecentInfo` containing information about the resource like its MIME type, or its display name.
lookup_item.md:
Searches for a URI inside the recently used resources list, and
returns a `GtkRecentInfo` containing information about the resource
like its MIME type, or its display name.

move_item.brief: Changes the location of a recently used resource from `uri` to `new_uri`.
move_item.md:
Changes the location of a recently used resource from `uri` to `new_uri`.

Please note that this function will not affect the resource pointed
by the URIs, but only the URI used in the recently used resources list.

purge_items.brief: Purges every item from the recently used resources list.
purge_items.md: Purges every item from the recently used resources list.

remove_item.brief: Removes a resource pointed by `uri` from the recently used resources list handled by a recent manager.
remove_item.md:
Removes a resource pointed by `uri` from the recently used resources
list handled by a recent manager.

filename.md:

changed.brief: Emitted when the current recently used resources manager changes its contents.
changed.md:
Emitted when the current recently used resources manager changes
its contents.

This can happen either by calling [`RecentManager.add_item()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.RecentManager#method:add_item)
or by another application.
